text: {"headline": "FDA's records show sodium bicarbonate injection shortage posted 2017-03-01 and 2017-07-24, still current as of 2026-10-21", "headline_cites": ["E432", "E436", "D82"], "sentences": [{"text": "FDA's shortage list shows sodium bicarbonate injection from Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. posted 2017-03-01 and from Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC posted 2017-07-24, both still current as of 2026-10-21.", "cites": ["E432", "E436", "D82"]}, {"text": "The shortage has been on FDA's list for 140 months as of 2026-10-21.", "cites": ["D82"]}, {"text": "FDA inspection records for plants on sodium chloride labels show multiple OAI classifications at Baxter Healthcare Corporation facilities, including inspections ending 2012-11-16, 2016-02-26, 2024-02-09, and 2026-04-02.", "cites": ["E138", "E141", "E144", "E154"]}, {"text": "FDA inspection records for plants on sodium chloride labels show OAI classifications at Hospira, Inc. facilities, including inspections ending 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, 2011-08-04, 2016-06-08, and 2018-08-15.", "cites": ["E180", "E182", "E184", "E196", "E198"]}, {"text": "FDA inspection records for plants on sodium chloride labels show OAI classifications at Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC facilities, including inspections ending 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11.", "cites": ["E290", "E293"]}, {"text": "The rule-based best option is to buy from Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.", "cites": ["D79"]}]}
